description: This file defines the enum class VoiceWakeMode for managing voice wake modes in the application, including methods for parsing raw string values into enum instances.

classes.name: VoiceWakeMode
classes.description: Enum class representing different modes for voice Wake functionality, such as Off, Foreground, and Always. Includes a companion object with a method to convert raw string values into enum instances.

methods.name: fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a raw string value into the corresponding VoiceWakeMode enum instance, defaulting to Foreground if no match is found.
